source.rights: Facts-only original methodological notes;no textbook corpus,figures or implementation copied. NOAA numerical subset retains attribution/public-domain policy. No Chronos assets acquired.

dataset.rights: NOAA government data public domain unless separately annotated;retain source/product credit,no endorsement or misrepresentation. Selected2000–2023 NOAA measurements avoid the pre1974 Scripps-sourced portion of the full file.

source.vintage: Retrospective evaluation on a fixed revised data snapshot. QC/calibration/midmonth corrections and2022–2023Maunakea substitution;historical publication vintages unverified. Prefix isolation does not prove historical source availability.
source.formula_provenance: Seasonal m4 and drift toy sequences are original arithmetic applications,not published empirical accuracy. SES geometric weights and FPP3 Google scoring examples separately source-attributed.

result.generic_seasonal: Manual seasonal_naive_m{m} for integer1..120 uses same algorithm and explicit period;only m12 is a NOAA benchmark candidate.
result.numeric: Plain finite decimal strings,<=64characters,<=30integer and24fraction digits;Fraction internal values. Exact fractions serialized with12-place HALF_EVEN decimal displays. RMSE retains exact rational radicand and80-digit Decimal square root rounded to12places. No float conversion of input.
result.selection: Lowest validation macro per-series MAE on all available target cells,then frozen candidate order. A candidate with any forecast failure or any series without scored validation cells is ineligible. No test-based choice;test-all is diagnostic only.
result.metrics: Per-cell scaled absolute error uses each origin training-only seasonal mean absolute difference. Aggregate MASE averages defined per-cell scaled errors with separate denominator;never divide aggregate MAE by average training scale. Bias actual-forecast. Paired candidate-minus-snaive MAE and ratio use common eligible cells;reference zero ->null ratio.
result.missing: Strict regular grid;null outcomes retained/unscored. Any missing training value fails the model for that origin;all planned cells retained. Unsupported evaluation candidates retained as unsupported;unsupported single forecasts reject.
result.distributional: Manual reference scoring only:strict increasing probabilities(0,1),nondecreasing quantiles,FPP3 twice-pinball;ordered central intervals,inclusive coverage,Winkler. No predictive intervals produced by point models.
result.benchmark: Frozen NOAA288rows,seven candidates,25+25origins,h1..12,300cells/model/partition,36distinct target months. Validation performed and selected before test computation;selected configuration frozen.
result.runtime: Offline CPU pure arithmetic;no optional model libraries. Resource evidence measured separately,frozen and referenced by hash;timings excluded from deterministic calculation.

supported: Generic regular monthly series and explicit seasonal-naive manual period
Exact rolling-origin point forecasts,metrics,validation-only choice and complete ledger
